Definition: to sustain; by implication, to obtain, keep fast; figuratively, to help, follow close
BiblicalUsage: God says, fear thou not, for I am with thee; I will strengthen thee, yea, I will help thee, yea, I will uphold thee with the right hand of My righteousness. Wisdom is a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her, and happy is every one that retaineth her. Aaron and Hur stay up Moses' hands until the going down of the sun, and David says, my soul followeth hard after Thee, Thy right hand upholdeth me. The word is to sustain, to keep fast, to hold up: God upholding His people, and His people laying hold on wisdom.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that upholding is God's promise before it is my effort. I believe Isaiah 41:10 is the verse to lean on: He upholds with His right hand, and my holding on is held by His holding me. Aaron and Hur show the other side — sometimes the upholding comes through friends who will not let your hands fall.
